summary: Plan EV charging infrastructure with load analysis, site screening, and deployment roadmaps. Learn practical tools for credible projects and safer rollout.
lede: EV charging infrastructure planning helps project, electrical, facilities, and sustainability professionals assess demand and plan practical charging deployments. The course covers load estimates, site screening, charger selection, electrical and operating requirements, stakeholder coordination, and commissioning, helping learners develop deployment roadmaps shaped by site capacity, usage, and project constraints.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who plan or support EV charging projects and need practical planning methods, not generic sustainability theory.
audience: Real estate and property development managers
prerequisites: Participants should bring a laptop, access to spreadsheet software, and any internal site or project data they can share subject to validation during the discovery session. Familiarity with electrical terminology, facilities planning, or capital project workflows will help, but the course is structured so intermediate professionals can apply the methods without advanced engineering software.
